$comment: Template for data/<league>/pool.json. `entriesAlive` is how many entries are still standing; `popularity` is the share of them on each team this week, keyed "<week>|<team>" like odds.json, and only the current week's keys are read (shares need not sum to one; the rest of the field is assumed spread across unlisted teams). `mode` is safest (the default, survival alone), equity (survival across futures times leverage) or balanced (equity, but only among openings whose chance this week is at least `floor`). The coach's own call never changes; the pool's preference is reported beside it in the refresh summary. Bump `updatedAt` whenever the file changes.
